meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从命令行动手搭建视频工程,校验后本地或云端渲染出成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要用代码批量制作视频并渲染导出成片
copy.tagline_en: Build video projects from the terminal, then validate and render them to final clips
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to script videos and render them locally or in the cloud

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 npx hyperframes 系列命令带你走完做视频的流程:建项目、在动效目录里查素材、检查、预览,最后渲染出 mp4 并确认文件存在且非空。运行需要 Node.js 22 或更新版本以及 FFmpeg。
howto.when: 当你要求用命令行创建、渲染等 HyperFrames 视频项目操作,或排查构建、渲染失败时触发;需要 Node.js 22+ 和 FFmpeg。

say.text: 帮我用 hyperframes init 建一个新视频项目
say.note: 会生成居中空白的项目骨架

say.text: 用 catalog 找一下“标题逐行出现”的动效
say.note: 查询需用英文描述动作

say.text: 检查通过后帮我渲染成 out.mp4
say.note: 会先跑 check 再编码,并验证文件非空

howto.what_en: Claude runs npx hyperframes commands through the video workflow: scaffold a project, search the motion catalog, lint/check, preview, then render an mp4 and confirm the file exists and is non-empty. Requires Node.js 22+ and FFmpeg.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask Claude to create, render and other HyperFrames video project tasks from the command line, or to diagnose build or render failures. Requires Node.js 22+ and FFmpeg.

say_en.text: Scaffold a new video project with hyperframes init
say_en.note: Creates a centered blank project skeleton

say_en.text: Search the catalog for a move that reveals a headline line by line
say_en.note: Queries must be written in English

say_en.text: Render to out.mp4 after checks pass
say_en.note: Runs check first, then encodes and verifies the file
